import {
  ITEM_LOG_FILE,
  computeBuckets,
  computeStatus,
  dashboardData,
  executionContractHash,
  findFeature,
  findWorksRoot,
  foldItemLog,
  foldWorld,
  listFeatures,
  liveCap,
  loopStats,
  parseLedger,
  readFeatureMeta,
  readItemLog,
  readLedgerState,
  readStageRecords,
  sharedMeta,
  statusToJson,
} from "@phuthuycoding/kanban-flow/lib";
import type {
  Action,
  ApprovalStatus,
  Buckets,
  Cap,
  CapCause,
  DashboardFilters,
  Feature,
  FeatureMeta,
  FeatureStatus,
  Finding,
  FoldResult,
  HeldRerun,
  ItemEvent,
  ItemRecord,
  ItemState,
  LedgerEvent,
  LedgerLine,
  LedgerRead,
  LedgerState,
  LegacyStageName,
  LoopInputs,
  LoopStats,
  LoopTask,
  ParsedLedger,
  RepairLine,
  Seat,
  SharedMeta,
  Stage,
  StageEvidence,
  StageRecord,
  TaskState,
  WaitingToMergeEntry,
  WorkItemKind,
  World,
} from "@phuthuycoding/kanban-flow/lib";

// Ledger readers.
const read: LedgerRead = readLedgerState("");
const state: LedgerState = read.ok ? read.state : { events: [] };
const repairs: RepairLine[] = read.ok ? [] : read.repair;
const events: LedgerEvent[] = state.events;
const parsed: ParsedLedger = parseLedger("");
const lines: LedgerLine[] = parsed.lines;
const stats: LoopStats = loopStats(parsed);
const tasksSeen: number = stats.tasks;

const task: LoopTask = { id: "TASK-001", dependencies: [], files: null, wave: 1, overlaps: [], inline: false, testTypes: ["Unit"] };
const inputs: LoopInputs = {
  feature: "demo", kind: "feature", level: null, tasks: [task],
  ceiling: { max: 2, source: "default" }, reportCommits: {}, verifyRuns: {}, gitLog: [],
};
const cap: Cap = liveCap(state, inputs);
const world: World = foldWorld(state, inputs, cap);
const taskState: TaskState | undefined = world.tasks.get("TASK-001");
const seat: Seat = "developer";
const cause: CapCause = { kind: "start" };
const actions: Action[] = cap.owed;
const held: HeldRerun[] = cap.contention.held;
const liveN: number = cap.n;

// Item readers.
const kind: WorkItemKind = "feature";
const stage: Stage = "planning";
const legacy: LegacyStageName = "shipping";
const approval: ApprovalStatus = "pending";
const root: string | null = findWorksRoot(".");
const meta: FeatureMeta | null = readFeatureMeta(".");
const features: Feature[] = listFeatures(".");
const one: Feature | null = findFeature(".", "demo");
const hash: string | null = executionContractHash(".", kind);
const records: StageRecord[] = one ? readStageRecords(one) : [];

// Read models.
const status: FeatureStatus | null = one ? computeStatus(one, ".") : null;
const json = status ? statusToJson(status) : null;
const buckets: Buckets = computeBuckets(status ? [status] : [], []);
const waiting: WaitingToMergeEntry[] = buckets.waitingToMerge;
const filters: DashboardFilters = { context: "cli", kind: "bug" };
const board = dashboardData(".", filters);
const blockers: Finding[] = status ? status.blockers : [];
const evidence: StageEvidence | null = status ? status.stageVerify : null;

// Lifecycle log.
const logFile: string = ITEM_LOG_FILE;
const folded: FoldResult = foldItemLog("");
const itemState: ItemState | null = folded.ok ? folded.state : null;
const fromDisk: FoldResult = readItemLog(".");
const shared: SharedMeta = sharedMeta({});
const event: ItemEvent = "created";
const record: Pick<ItemRecord, "v" | "event"> = { v: 1, event };

// A type that resolved to `any` would make these directives unused, which is an error.
// @ts-expect-error Cap.n is a number, not a string
const notAString: string = cap.n;
// @ts-expect-error "bogus" is not a Stage
const notAStage: Stage = "bogus";

export const used = [
  repairs, events, lines, tasksSeen, taskState, seat, cause, actions, held, liveN, legacy, approval, root, meta,
  features, hash, records, json, waiting, board, blockers, evidence, logFile, itemState, fromDisk, shared, record,
  notAString, notAStage, stage, world,
];
